Part 2&3 事件 EVENTS

Describe a time you needed to use your imagination

描述一次你需要发挥想象力的时刻

⚠️ AI 范例，仅供学习 — IELTS 口语全程独立完成，背诵照搬 AI 答案会被考官识别为背稿。

Part 2 话题卡片

Describe a time you needed to use your imagination

  • When it was (是什么时候)
  • Why you needed to use imagination (你为什么需要发挥想象力)
  • How difficult or easy it was (是难还是容易)
  • And explain how you felt about it (并谈谈你当时的感受)

问题与答案

Cue CardDescribe a time you needed to use your imagination

I'd like to talk about a time when I really needed to use my imagination, and that was during my final year of high school. It was a period when I had to sit through long revision sessions, and honestly, I often felt extremely bored, especially during the afternoon classes when the teacher was just going over the same material again and again. The reason I needed to use my imagination was simple, I had nothing else to do. We weren't allowed to use our phones in class, so whenever my mind drifted, I would start daydreaming to pass the time. I remember creating whole imaginary worlds in my head, like planning a trip around the world, designing my dream apartment, or even imagining what my life would be like after the exams, which university I would attend and what kind of job I might get. As for how difficult it was, I'd say it was actually quite easy, because daydreaming comes naturally to me. The hard part was snapping back to reality when the teacher suddenly asked me a question. I remember being caught off guard a couple of times, which was a bit embarrassing. Looking back, I think those daydreams were more than just a way to kill time. They gave me a sense of hope and motivation during a stressful period, and they made the boring hours pass much faster. So even though it sounds a little silly, I'm actually grateful for my imagination, because it turned dull moments into something enjoyable.

高三复习课很无聊，不能玩手机，我就靠脑内异想天开打发时间，想象环球旅行、梦想公寓和考后生活；白日梦很容易做，但被老师点名会尴尬；它给了我希望和动力。

Q2Do you think adults can have lots of imagination?

Absolutely, I think adults can be just as imaginative as children, although they often hide it. The difference is that adults usually apply their imagination to practical things, like solving problems at work or planning for the future. For example, entrepreneurs need imagination to invent new products. Having said that, adults may lose some of their playful imagination because of daily routines and stress, and I think it's important for them to make time for creative activities.

成年人同样有想象力，只是常隐藏；他们更多把想象用于实际，如工作解决问题、规划未来；但日常压力会消磨玩心，应留时间做创造性活动。

Q3Do you think imagination is essential for scientists?

Yes, I believe it's absolutely essential. Science isn't just about memorising facts, it's about imagining possibilities that don't exist yet. For instance, Einstein imagined riding on a beam of light before he developed his theory of relativity. Scientists also need imagination to design experiments and to picture how things might work. So in my view, imagination and logic work together in science, and without imagination, many great discoveries would never have been made.

想象力对科学家至关重要；科学不只是记事实，而是想象尚未存在的可能，如爱因斯坦想象骑光束；设计实验也需要想象，想象与逻辑相辅相成。

Q4What kinds of jobs need imagination?

Quite a few jobs need imagination, but the most obvious ones are in the creative industries, like writers, designers, architects and advertising professionals, because they have to come up with original ideas every day. However, I'd argue that imagination matters in almost every job. For example, a teacher needs imagination to make lessons interesting, and even an engineer needs it to solve unusual problems. So I think imagination is valuable everywhere, it's just more visible in creative roles.

创意行业最需要想象力，如作家、设计师、建筑师、广告人；但几乎所有工作都需要，老师要想象让课有趣，工程师要想象解决难题，只是创意岗位更明显。

Q5What subjects are helpful for children's imagination?

I'd say arts subjects are the most helpful, like drawing, music and drama, because they encourage children to express themselves freely. Literature is also great, since reading stories lets children picture whole worlds in their minds. That said, I don't think imagination is limited to the arts, because subjects like science and maths can also spark curiosity when taught well. So on the whole, the subject matters less than how it's taught, and children need a mix of both.

艺术类科目最有助于想象力，如绘画、音乐、戏剧，文学也能让孩子在脑中构建世界；但科学数学教得好同样激发好奇，关键在教法而非科目本身。

Q6What games help develop children's imagination?

I think role-playing games are the best for developing imagination, because children have to create characters and stories themselves. Building games, like blocks or LEGO, are also great, since children have to picture what they want to create before they build it. Having said that, I think the key is that the game should be open-ended, so children can use their own ideas rather than just following rules.

角色扮演游戏最能培养想象力，孩子要自己创造角色和故事，如过家家、扮医生；积木类搭建游戏也好，关键是游戏要开放，让孩子用自己的想法而非只守规则。

Q7How important is imagination to children?

I'd say imagination is extremely important for children's development. It helps them understand the world, solve problems and express their emotions, especially when they can't put feelings into words. For example, a child who imagines being a superhero may be practising courage. Imagination also supports learning, because children who can picture things in their minds often understand new concepts more easily. So in my view, imagination isn't just play, it's a foundation for creativity and confidence later in life.

想象力对孩子发展极其重要；帮他们理解世界、解决问题、表达情绪，如想象自己是超级英雄是在练习勇气；也促进学习，是未来创造力和自信的基础。
